description: Insert a macro (sub-workflow) into a dynamic workflow. Connects macro input ports to existing nodes. Returns nodeIdMap and outputPorts so you can connect macro outputs. Use workflow_id from create_workflow.

input_connections.description: Map port name -> [source node id, output index] for links, or literal (e.g. filename for LoadImage)

macro_id.description: Macro id (e.g. upscale_refine). Use list_macros to see available.

name: insert_macro
